items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I played plenty of funerals with the old Eureka. But I mean, before they had this group, I mean, when they had Dajama playing trumpet group, Mama Dajama, and T-Boy Remy, and First Humphrey

ctx.x: Did you have any other name for his band?

No, his name was Allen's brass band, Allen's brass band. That was his name. Quite natural. I played plenty of funerals with the old Eureka. But I mean, before they had this group, I mean, when they had Dajama playing trumpet group, Mama Dajama, and T-Boy Remy, and First Humphrey, and several other older guys that did, see. And at that time, this guy named him again, Big Landry was the leader of that band. Now he was the only, he was the last trumpet player around there, playing in, he was in a parade that was…
